law_record.title: Duty of driver to move out of left lane when traveling at a certain rate of speed (1)
law_record.text: Except as otherwise provided in subsection 2, on a controlled-access highway which has two or more clearly marked lanes for traveling in the same direction, a driver may not continue to operate a motor vehicle in the extreme left lane if the driver knows, or reasonably should know, that he or she is traveling at a rate of speed which is less than the posted speed limit for that portion of the controlled-access highway and is being overtaken in that lane from the rear by a motor vehicle traveling at a higher rate of speed. The requirements of subsection 1 do not apply: (a) To a driver operating a motor vehicle that is: (1) Overtaking another vehicle proceeding in the same direction; (2) Preparing for a left turn at an intersection; (3) Traveling in a lane designated for the use of high-occupancy vehicles pursuant to NRS 484A.460, if the driver complies with the requirements to travel in such a lane [DEF-NRS-484A-460-2, NRS-484B-323-1]; or (4) Engaged in the construction, maintenance or repair of the highway, including, without limitation, the removal of snow. (b) When traffic conditions, inclement weather, obstructions or hazards make it necessary to drive in the extreme left lane. (c) When compliance with an official traffic control device or the directions given by a peace officer makes it necessary to drive in the extreme left lane. (d) To the driver of an authorized emergency vehicle in the course of his or her official duties. (e) To a driver operating a motor vehicle within the geographical limits of a city or town.

activation_conditions: the subject is on a controlled-access highway with two or more marked lanes in its direction
the subject occupies the extreme left lane
the subject's speed is below the posted limit for that portion
a faster motor vehicle is overtaking the subject from the rear in that lane
exceptions: the subject is itself overtaking another vehicle going the same way
the subject is preparing for a left turn at an intersection
the subject is in a high-occupancy lane and complies with its requirements
the subject is engaged in construction, maintenance or repair of the highway, including snow removal
traffic conditions, inclement weather, obstructions or hazards make the left lane necessary
a traffic control device or a peace officer's direction makes the left lane necessary
an authorized emergency vehicle on official duty
inside the geographical limits of a city or town
residue: 'knows, or reasonably should know' is interior state; the observable substitute is that the overtaking vehicle was closing and in the subject's line of sight (rel.visible)
the city-or-town limits exception is a legal region class — a reading assumption
the HOV compliance condition cites a provision outside the corpus
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: 'may not continue to operate' — the offence is persistence: a bound on how long the subject may remain in the lane after the overtaking vehicle closes must be declared
the faster vehicle's approach precedes the window in which the subject must clear the lane
